headline: ~120 contracts catalogued on Ethereum from 3F's official docs: 9 Safes, 1 timelock, 11 factories, 12 beacons, core and operational contracts; no on-chain reads done.

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search was not possible. A grounded search for the Facility address returned only generic Etherscan pages and no 3F tag. No block-explorer page was fetched, so no name tags were verified. See the D1-offchain unknown.

docs.3f.xyz/protocol/deployments/ is the canonical deployments page. For Ethereum mainnet it lists Core (11), Factories (11), Beacons (12), Implementations, EIP-7702 account, Request scripts and external dependencies. The docs also publish /deployments.json, which was not fetched. Base is marked 'Soon' and Sepolia is a testnet.

docs.3f.xyz/protocol/ownership/ is a snapshot of on-chain state at block 26,076,588 (Sept 28, 2026). It lists 9 Safes with thresholds and signers, operational hot accounts, the Upgrade Timelock (24h min delay), ERC-1967 proxies with admins, and two Zodiac Roles Modifiers. Safes: 3F_ADMIN_PROTECTED 2/3, 3F_PM_OWNER 2/3, FAC_FUND 2/3, REPAYER 2/3, 3F_OWNER 4/7, 3F_LABS 2/5, 3F_DEV 2/3, 3F_LEAD 1/2, 3F_FOUNDATION 1/2. These are the docs' claims; none were read via the read API or an explorer.

The docs audits page lists 6 smart-contract audits: Cantina Nov 2026, Sep 2026, May 2026 and a May 2026 fee review, plus ChainSecurity Apr 2026 (Grunt) and Apr 2026 (Grunt Funds). It also lists an Opsek OpSec audit (Nov 2026). The PDFs were not opened, so no audit-scope address tables were extracted.

github.com/3FLabs lists 10 repos. The relevant ones are grunt (contracts), facilitators (registry of facilitator contracts), 3f-request-whitelist, 3f-guardian (off-chain signer) and a morpho-blue fork. No repo files or commit SHAs were fetched, so no deployment artifacts were walked.
Only Ethereum is in protocol.chains. The docs deployments page lists Base as 'Soon' and Sepolia as testnet; no Base or Sepolia addresses were catalogued.

No factory enumeration was done. The ownership page counts 44 PositionManagers, 40 Retargetters, 10 CentrifugeFunds, 17 USCCFunds, 14 ParetoFunds, 16 MidasFunds and 43 Facility-bound Requests. These children were not enumerated individually.
Roles were assigned from the docs' own labels. Actor classes for Safes are taken from the ownership page and not verified from bytecode.
Every address in admin_addresses traces to a fetched docs page (deployments, ownership) or the fetched 3f.xyz homepage. No snippet-only addresses were included.

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice, so grade is unknown by definition: walked 3F website, docs (deployments, ownership, audits, bug bounty) and the GitHub org page, and catalogued ~120 Ethereum addresses from docs only. Explorer, read-API, audit PDF and repo-file corpora were not walked.

evidence.shows: Protocol website. 3F is described as a vault protocol built on Morpho for leveraged exposure to tokenized RWAs, Ethereum mainnet. Links to docs, audits, bug bounty and GitHub. Links the Morpho vault 3F x Steakhouse USDC at 0xBEEf3f3A04e28895f3D5163d910474901981183D.
GitHub org with 10 repos, including grunt, facilitators, 3f-request-whitelist, 3f-guardian and morpho-blue (fork). No commit SHA was pinned.
Docs landing page. Links to Protocol, Bridge Facilitators, Liquidators and Developers sections, and to github.com/3FLabs/grunt.

Canonical Ethereum mainnet deployments. Core: Facility proxy 0x4e01...4A4F, TransferGuard, IntentDescriptor, MorphoRebalancer, RequestWhitelist proxy, BorrowOffersRegistry proxy, Liquidation Offer Guardian, Upgrade Timelock 0xC1ab...6fA5, RetargetterQuoter, MorphoFlashLoanAdapter. Also 11 factories, 12 beacons, implementations, an EIP-7702 account, Request scripts and Morpho Blue, Adaptive Curve IRM and USDC as external dependencies. Base is 'Soon'; Sepolia is testnet.

On-chain ownership snapshot (docs-reported, block 26,076,588). Safes with thresholds and signers, operational accounts, Upgrade Timelock with 24h min delay and role holders, ERC-1967 proxies and admins, role holders per contract, Zodiac Roles Modifiers, and unlisted contracts. Derived: actor classes are as stated by the docs, not verified by this run.

Lists 6 smart-contract audits (Cantina x4, ChainSecurity x2) with GitHub PDF links under 3FLabs/grunt/audits, and an Opsek OpSec audit (Nov 2026). Cantina Nov 2026 reviewed commit 006c5a13 (fix review fea207db).
Public bug bounty on Cantina, live since June 2, 2026, up to $250,000 for critical findings. Link: https://cantina.xyz/bounties/d558609e-d378-446b-a69d-2a577533f333.

unknowns: D1-offchain: Etherscan name-tag search was not possible. Only one search query ('etherscan 3F Labs Facility <address>') was run and it returned no 3F-tagged pages. No etherscan.io searchHandler or address page was fetched this run (fetch budget exhausted), so name tags and neighbouring labels are unverified.
D1: Name-tag search was not repeated with a second query; site:etherscan.io 3F queries remain to be done by a later run.

D2: Per-asset deployment pages (wjaaa, wuscc, wfalconx, wmglo, partner-vaults) were not fetched. Per-asset wrapped assets, Morpho markets, PositionManagers, Retargetters and Funds are therefore not catalogued.
D2: https://docs.3f.xyz/deployments.json and the Deployments API page (docs.3f.xyz/developer/deployments-api/) were not fetched. They would give a machine-readable full list.

D2: Older and secondary implementation addresses in the deployments 'Implementations' table (old PositionManager, TransferGuard, Request, USCCFund beacons and so on) were not added to admin_addresses. Only core, factory, beacon, proxy, Safe, signer and operational addresses were catalogued.

D2: The Partner vaults TransferGuard 0xE1544f832B3317f32368d0CA5ba7ea053E1112aB was found on the ownership page only. SyncAllocatorDeposit script and the PositionManager/Retargetter children were not enumerated.

D3: Audit PDFs (Cantina x4, ChainSecurity x2, Opsek) were not opened. Scope address tables were not extracted. The Cantina audit-era commit SHAs on the audits page (006c5a13, fea207db, 9ae1b3cf) were not fetched.

D4: github.com/3FLabs/grunt and github.com/3FLabs/facilitators were not walked (no broadcast/, deployments/ or deployments.json inspected, no commit SHA pinned). The 3f-request-whitelist and 3f-guardian repos were not inspected.
D5: Base is marked 'Soon' in the docs and Sepolia is testnet; no Base address exists yet in the docs. Re-check Base when it goes live.

D6: Factory enumeration via read API was not attempted. No surfacer URLs were pinned and generated URLs would not be allowlisted. Children not enumerated: PositionManagerFactory 0x8E06...E5fA (44 PMs), RetargetterFactory 0xb1A5...E07F (40), CentrifugeFundFactory (10), USCCFundFactory (17), ParetoFundFactory (14), MidasFundFactory (16), RequestFactory 0xDE29...2Ca5 (63+ Requests), MorphoBorrowPositionFactory.

D7: actor_class for Safe, smart-account and EOA entries is taken from the docs ownership page and was not verified from bytecode or the Safe owners read API. The Safes' signer sets and thresholds should be re-read on-chain by the control slice.
D8: No on-chain read-API or explorer page was fetched this run, so no address in admin_addresses is confirmed on-chain by this run.

D8: Two Roles-Modifier modules (0x1416ebd818B3A6c7EB287b341d2c1637664156D6 and 0xCBB347c09eBAb616ffB2A6D79F07b9cF8C728D0F) were reported on the ownership page as still-enabled but revoked. They are not included in admin_addresses.
D2: governance_forum, voting_token and security_contact were not found in fetched pages. The protocol appears not to be token-governed, but this was not verified.

protocol_metadata.about: 3F is a leverage protocol built on Morpho Blue that lets users take leveraged positions on tokenized real-world assets (e.g. wrapped JAAA, USCC, FalconX and mGLO tokens) through PositionManager vaults. A Facility coordinates facilitator-provided bridge financing and Requests to enter and exit positions, and lenders supply stablecoins via Morpho vaults. Contracts are largely proxy/beacon based with upgrades routed through a timelock.
